A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.9.26; 
father of: Gaal (H1603)
§ Ebed = "servant"
1) father of Gaal in the time of the judges
2) son of Jonathan and one of the sons of Adin who returned from exile with Ezra

A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.38.7 
§ Ebed-melech = "servant of the king"
an Ethiopian eunuch in the service of king Zedekiah, through whose interference Jeremiah was released from prison

A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.21; 
son of: Shelah (H7974); 
father of: Peleg (H6389) and Joktan (H3355)
Also named: Eber (Ἐβέρ "Eber" G1443)
§ Eber or Heber = "the region beyond"
1) son of Salah, great grandson of Shem, father of Peleg and Joktan
2) a Gadite chief
3) a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and descendant of Sharahaim
4) a Benjamite, son of Shashak
5) a priest in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua

Ἔβερ (Rec. Ἐβέρ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. עֵבֶר, Gen.10.24), 
Eber (OT, Heber): Luk.3.35.†
(AS)
